changelog:
Night after night. Smart Power-Saving AOD: Simple Clock and Quick Entity fade to minimal black display after configurable delay, first touch wakes without accidental activation. Rooted devices optional Smart CPU Throttle. AMOLED benefit most. Thanks @TWINKLY09 #142.

Screensaver idle timeout exposed to HA. Screensaver switch bidirectional. Browser Keep Screen On prevents sleep only while visible. Thanks @lone-baggie #146, @xxtraPickles #149 #151.

Music overlay HA switch: show/hide expanded player, syncs both ways. Mini button never leaves switch stuck. Thanks @lone-baggie #144.

Android broadcast intents supported in launch-intent control. Thanks @pantherale0 #143.

microWakeWord second offline verification reduces false wakes. Voice input health detection auto-rebuilds pipeline on silent/invalid audio. Thanks @meiser79 #116, @pantherale0 @lone-baggie #140.

TTS completion watchdog prevents stuck Responding. Thanks @lone-baggie #145, @alexreddy78 #89.

Bluetooth proxy self-recovery: stale scan auto-restart, deeper recovery with root/Shizuku. Thanks @deergitseason #148.

Floating interfaces: mini button no longer blocks screensaver, service stop closes overlays consistently, back-button and fade fixes. AirPlay 1.0.63 and DLNA 1.5.9 display-scale controls.

Backup identity: device name and MAC no longer copied, prevents HA duplicates. Thanks @inventor7777 #147.
